OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Gate’s Stock CFD Zone has launched ANT (Anthropic) contracts for difference (CFDs).
Trading rewards are now available. Register and trade to receive 5 USDx and get up to 50 USDx in trading loss subsidies. Meet the cumulative trading volume requirement to compete on the leaderboard for a share of 3,000 USDx, with up to 1,000 USDx per user. Rewards can be combined and are available in limited quantities on a first-come, first-served basis.
Join Now
## Event period: November 20, 2026, 10:00 – December 4, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
## Eligible instrument: ANT CFD
## Event 1: ANT Welcome Bonus—Trade to Receive 5 USDx
During the event, register and reach a cumulative ANT CFD trading volume of at least 500 USDx to receive a reward worth 5 USDx. Limited to the first 3,000 eligible users. Rewards are credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis until the allocation is exhausted.
## Event 2: ANT Trading Subsidy—Get Up to 50 USDx
During the event, if your first ANT CFD trade after registration is closed within the event period and results in an actual net loss, you will receive a subsidy equal to that loss, up to 50 USDx per user.
Limited to the first 500 eligible users, determined by when they close their first trade. The total subsidy pool is capped at 25,000 USDx. Rewards are available until the allocation is exhausted.
Note: Trades completed using a CFD Position Voucher are not eligible for this subsidy.
## Event 3: ANT Trading Leaderboard—Win Up to 1,000 USDx
During the event, register and reach a cumulative ANT CFD trading volume of at least 5,000 USDx to qualify for the trading volume leaderboard. Participants will be ranked by cumulative ANT CFD trading volume, from highest to lowest, with the top 50 receiving rewards based on their rank. The total prize pool is worth 3,000 USDx, with up to 1,000 USDx per user, available until the allocation is exhausted.
Rank | Reward per User
1st Place | 1,000 USDx
2nd–3rd Place | 200 USDx
4th–10th Place | 100 USDx
11th–20th Place | 60 USDx
21st–50th Place | 10 USDx
Note: If users have the same cumulative ANT CFD trading volume, the user who reached the 5,000 USDx entry threshold first will rank higher.
## Important Notes
All participants must complete identity verification before registering and click [Join Now] to register for the event. Registration and participation are currently unavailable in some regions due to local policies and service restrictions.
Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume. Only ANT CFD trading volume generated after registration counts toward this event. Trading volume from other CFD instruments is excluded.
All event rewards will be issued as CFD Trading Fee Rebate Vouchers with a 20% rebate rate.
Event 1 rewards will be credited to your account automatically after you complete the task. For Events 2 and 3, the button text will remain unchanged after task completion. Rewards will be credited to your account within 14 business days after the event ends and the data review is completed. If no reward is credited, the reward allocation has been exhausted or you did not meet the task requirements.
For Event 2, net loss is calculated using the actual settlement result of your first ANT CFD trade after registration, once the position is closed. Trades that do not result in an actual net loss, are not closed during the event, or use a CFD Position Voucher are not eligible for the Event 2 subsidy.
Gate TradFi services may be restricted in certain jurisdictions, and users in some regions are temporarily unable to use this feature. Trading traditional financial instruments involves market volatility, leverage risk, and liquidity risk. Before enabling TradFi trading, carefully read the Contract for Difference (CFD) Service Agreement, the Risk Disclosure Statement, and the terms for each asset class.
Users who participate in other Gate events of the same type during the same period can receive rewards from only one event.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the event. Prohibited conduct includes using multiple accounts to participate repeatedly, impersonating others or submitting false identity verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, coordinating to obtain rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the event. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Market makers, companies, and institutions are not eligible to participate in this event.

Gate retains final authority to interpret the terms of this event.

## What Is a Prediction Market?
A prediction market lets participants trade on the outcome of a future event. Each market asks a clearly defined question and offers outcomes such as “Yes” and “No.”
The price of each outcome reflects the market’s current implied probability. For example, a “Yes” price of 0.65 suggests the market currently assigns about a 65% chance to that outcome. It is a market view, not a guarantee.
## What Can You Trade on KuCoin Predictions?
KuCoin Predictions gives eligible users access to supported Polymarket markets within the KuCoin App. Market categories include:
Crypto: Trade on cryptocurrency price movements.
Sports: Trade on the outcomes of sporting events.
Politics: Trade on the outcomes of political events.
Crypto Up or Down markets support BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, DOGE, and HYPE, with 5-minute, 15-minute, and 4-hour intervals. Check the App for the specific asset and interval combinations currently available to you.
Each market has its own question, time window, and settlement rules. Read them carefully before trading. Available markets are subject to regional and account eligibility.
## How Does a Trade Work?
Buying 10 “Yes” shares at an average price of $0.65 costs $6.50 before fees. In a normally resolved market:
If “Yes” wins, those shares settle for $10 in total, giving a gross profit of $3.50 before fees.
If “No” wins, those shares settle at $0, and the $6.50 is lost.
You may also be able to sell before settlement, depending on market status, liquidity, and applicable price protection.
KuCoin provides the in-app interface and account functions. Polymarket provides the underlying markets, rules, prices, liquidity, order execution, and outcome resolution. KuCoin does not independently determine market outcomes.
## Watch: How to Place Your First Trade
Watch this step-by-step tutorial, then follow the guide below to place your first trade on KuCoin Predictions.
## Step 1: Find Predictions
Open the KuCoin App in Pro mode and go to Markets > Predictions.
Access is available only to eligible accounts in supported regions. Complete Identity Verification (KYC) and check that Predictions is available to you.
## Step 2: Choose a Market and Read Its Rules
Browse Crypto, Sports, or Politics and select a market you understand. Check the available outcomes, trading deadline, applicable time zone, resolution criteria, and designated result source or Oracle. Two markets about the same event may settle differently if their wording or deadlines are different.
## Step 3: Choose an Outcome
Select the outcome that matches your assessment. The displayed price reflects current market pricing; it does not guarantee that the outcome will win.
## Step 4: Enter an Amount and Select Your Payment Account
Enter the amount of USDT you want to use. Funding Account is selected by default. If you select Financial Account or Trading Account, the required USDT will be transferred automatically to Funding Account. Before continuing, review the estimated price, estimated shares, and any applicable fees.
## Step 5: View Your Position
Go to Predictions > Assets to view your position and trading records.
If selling is available, you may submit a new market order before trading ends. An early exit is not guaranteed and depends on market status, liquidity, and price protection. After normal resolution under the corresponding Polymarket market rules, each winning share settles at $1 and each losing share at $0. Settlement proceeds are credited automatically to your Funding Account; no manual on-chain redemption is required. View the record under Predictions > Assets > History. Key risks include price volatility, limited liquidity and slippage, and delayed, disputed, or invalidated resolution. Ready to explore? Open Markets > Predictions and choose a market whose rules you understand. Only trade an amount you can afford to lose.
